subject: Human Evolution
title: Last Refugia
description: Learn Last Refugia in one minute.

hook.text: The last known Neanderthals clung to the southern tip of Spain, in Gibraltar, around 40,000 years ago.

buildup.text: Gorham's Cave held Neanderthal tools and hearths—a final redoubt on the edge of the continent.

discovery.text: Here they carved hashtag-like patterns into rock—one of the last traces of Neanderthal symbolic behavior.

twist.text: Some dates suggest they may have survived even later. The exact end date is still fiercely debated.

climax.text: A species that endured 300,000 years of ice ages was finally cornered and faded on a sunlit coast.

punchline.text: The last Neanderthal watched the Mediterranean alone.

quiz.question: Where were some of the last Neanderthals found?
options: Gibraltar, at the southern tip of Spain
